description: Header file defining the VirtualInput class and related classes for virtual input handling, including key mapping, event dispatching, and IPC integration within the Thunder PluginHost namespace.

classes.name: VirtualInput
classes.description: Abstract base class for virtual input devices, managing key mappings, event dispatching, and IPC communication.

classes.name: VirtualInput::RepeatKeyTimer
classes.description: Handles timing for repeated key events.

classes.name: VirtualInput::KeyMap
classes.description: Manages key code to key mapping, including modifiers and import/export functionality.

classes.name: VirtualInput::KeyMap::KeyMapEntry
classes.description: Represents a single key mapping entry with code, key, and modifiers.

classes.name: VirtualInput::PostLookupTable
classes.description: Stores key code conversion mappings for post-processing.

classes.name: VirtualInput::Iterator
classes.description: Iterates over consumers of input events.

classes.name: VirtualInput::INotifier
classes.description: Interface for input event notification callbacks.

classes.name: VirtualInput::InputDataLink
classes.description: Handles IPC data linking for input events.

classes.name: PluginHost::InputHandler
classes.description: Manages initialization and deinitialization of input devices, supporting device and virtual types.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends input data (key, mouse, or touch) to the system.
